The gradient of a function f:Rm×n→R with respect to a matrix X∈Rm×n is ∇Xf(X)=[∂f∂x11∂f∂x12⋯∂f∂x1n∂f∂x21∂f∂x22⋯∂f∂x2n⋮⋮⋱⋮∂f∂xm1∂f∂xm2⋯∂f∂xmn].

In our case, writing out the function f(X) where X=[x11x12x21x22]∈R2×2, we get f(X)=(det(X))2=(x11x22−x12x21)2.

So, the gradient is ∇Xf(X)=[∂f∂x11∂f∂x12∂f∂x21∂f∂x22]=[∂∂x11(x11x22−x12x21)2∂∂x12(x11x22−x12x21)2∂∂x21(x11x22−x12x21)2∂∂x22(x11x22−x12x21)2]=[2(x11x22−x12x21)⋅x222(x11x22−x12x21)⋅(−x21)2(x11x22−x12x21)⋅(−x12)2(x11x22−x12x21)⋅x11]=2(x11x22−x12x21)[x22−x21−x12x11]=2det(X)[x22−x21−x12x11].

Evaluating at X=[4−131], we get ∇Xf(X)=2(4⋅1−(−1)⋅3)[1−314]=[14−421456].
